messages:
alex: Cutting RC3 from branch release/edge-routing now. Build: rwinf-2026.03.20-rc3 (sha: ab12c3f). Planning promotion to prod in the 23:00 PT change window if we get fast signoffs. Can we get SRE/QA/PM +1s?

deploy-bot: RC created: rwinf-2026.03.20-rc3 · pipeline: https://ci.redwood.example/p/4823 · artifacts: s3://rwinf-artifacts/rc3/ · scheduled promo window: 2026-03-20T23:00:00-07:00 PT

priya: quick Q — what's the canary plan? default 5% -> 25% -> 50% with 10m observation? Also define rollback triggers (error rate, latency, larger-than-expected tokens).

jason: staging smoke passed 3 runs in a row, latency p95 looks stable. I ran the perf harness with sequences up to 1024.

monica: found a flaky integration test in qa: `user-context-merge.test` fails intermittently on redis timeout. Failing log snippet:
```
ERR timeout connecting to redis at 10.0.2.7:6379
at workspace/merge.go:142
```
I pushed a small retry patch in #4862, request QA re-run. If we don't fix, we should consider pinning RC to exclude the integration change.

alex: Thanks. Two options: 1) delay promo 2h for patch and re-run, or 2) promote RC3 but pin deploy to exclude the integration change (cherry-pick). Which does PM prefer?

sam: Business prefers delay by <=2h rather than risk rollback. We have a customer demo tomorrow morning. If patch is quick, go for delay.

jason: Patch looks tiny, but it needs a config tweak on Dedicated infra too. I'll coordinate with infra now. ETA 35m.

priya: For rollback triggers, propose: error-rate > 1.5x baseline OR p95 latency increase > 40% sustained for 5m OR elevated OOMs on GPU hosts. If any trigger fires, automatic rollback to last-stable tag `rwinf-2026.03.19-prod` and scale down canary to 0.

alex: agreed. Documenting rollback cmd for oncall: `deploy-bot promote --to-tag rwinf-2026.03.19-prod --env prod --force` and fallback route flip: `infractl route set default --tag rwinf-2026.03.19-prod`

sarah-oncall: I will monitor the canary window. I'll add the SLO watch and pager thresholds. @deploy-bot please post canary metrics to #eng-oncall during rollout.

deploy-bot: Promotion plan (manual approval required):
- step 1: promote rc tag to prod (canary 5%)
- step 2: observe 10m metrics (errors, latency, GPU mem)
- step 3: if ok -> canary 25% -> observe 10m -> 50% -> full
Command: `deploy-bot promote --env prod --tag rwinf-2026.03.20-rc3 --canary 5 --auto-step false`

monica: QA: rerun started on rc3 with retry patch, currently at 45% of tests. Will report pass/fail in 20m.

jason: infra change applied for redis retry cfg. re-running smoke locally, looks green.

alex: ok holding promo until QA confirms. New tentative promo time 23:45 PT if green. Please react with :thumbsup: when you actually signoff.

priya: SRE +1 for rollout plan and rollback triggers.

monica: QA +1 — all relevant tests passed after retry patch. No regressions on embeddings or streaming endpoints.

sam: PM +1, we can accept the slight delay.

sarah-oncall: oncall +1, I will be present for canary window. Pager escalation plan in place.

alex: thanks all. @deploy-bot proceed to schedule manual approval for 23:45 PT. Once I approve I'll run the promote command.

deploy-bot: Manual approval scheduled: 2026-03-20T23:45:00-07:00 PT. Approval URL: https://ci.redwood.example/p/4823/approve

alex: Approved and kicked off promo at 23:45 PT. Starting canary 5%.

deploy-bot: Canary started · 5% traffic -> rwinf-2026.03.20-rc3 · Observing metrics for 10m. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/canary/rc3

priya: watching metrics. error-rate baseline 0.2% -> current 0.22% ok. p95 +6% -> ok. No OOMs.

jason: running synthetic smoke against canary nodes, CPU and GPU loads normal.

sarah-oncall: no alerts. continuing watch.

alex: promote to 25% now.

deploy-bot: Canary advanced -> 25% (manual). Observing 10m.

priya: metrics stable. No abnormal logs.

sarah-oncall: still green.

alex: promote to 50% and then full once green 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary advanced -> 50%.

monica: quick sanity check on embeddings route — looks good.

priya: advancing to full traffic. No triggers.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete · rwinf-2026.03.20-rc3 is now serving 100% prod traffic. Release notes: https://docs.redwood.example/releases/2026-03-20-rc3.md

alex: Release complete. Rolling release notes to #general and updating release tracker. Thanks team. :tada:
